function track(_t: unknown, c: ClassAccessorDecoratorContext) {
  c.addInitializer(function (this: any) { console.log('init', String(c.name), this.a, this.b); });
}
class Counter {
  @track accessor a = 1;
  b = 2;
  @track static accessor s = 3;
}
new Counter();
console.log('constructed');
const registry: string[] = [];
function withLogging(cls: any, _c: ClassDecoratorContext): any {
  return class extends cls { logged = true; };
}
@withLogging
class Service {
  static self = this;
  static {
    registry.push('registered ' + (this === Service));
  }
  static instance = new Service();
  static make() { return new Service(); }
  same() { return this instanceof Service; }
}
console.log(Service.self === Service, registry.join(','), (Service.instance as any).logged);
console.log((Service.make() as any).logged, new Service().same(), (new Service() as any).logged);
function callOnInit(_t: unknown, c: ClassMethodDecoratorContext) {
  c.addInitializer(function (this: any) { this.check(); });
}
class Base {}
class Guarded extends Base {
  #label() { return 'ready'; }
  get #code() { return 7; }
  @callOnInit check() { console.log(this.#label(), this.#code); }
}
new Guarded();
